title: Former spy found himself accused, then cleared, twice in '80s MJ-12 leak -- Part 2 - Mystery Wire
description: https://www.mysterywire.com/ The spy became a suspect twice in the 1980s as former Air Force special investigator Rick Doty found the government pointing a finger at him. Doty, an intelligence insider for 10 years, tells investigative reporter George Knapp that UFO investigations continued under the Defense Intelligence Agency after Project Blue Book shut down. Previously unaired. Recorded in 2019 at the UFO Mega Conference in Laughlin, Nevada. Part two of 5. #MysteryWire
